claims.text: The FDA lovastatin label flags substantial alcohol consumption in its liver warning.
claims.quote: The drug should be used with caution in patients who consume substantial quantities of alcohol and/or have a past history of liver disease.

headline.text: The FDA lovastatin label flags substantial alcohol consumption in its liver warning.

reported.text: The label does not quantify the alcohol-related risk in this statement.

gaps.text: The packet contains no controlled human study of alcohol with lovastatin; the alcohol finding for fluvastatin concerns a different drug.
